description.narrative: The Ministry of State Administration and Public Service (MAEFP) is the focal point for coordinating the decentralisation working group at national level and Ireland has assumed the Chair of the group for 2024/25. In this role Ireland will support the 10th Coordinating Council of the Ministry to align national work plans and share best practice on public administration including in decentralised entities. The choice of location was due to the fact that the locality of Ponta do Ouro is undergoing rapid development, which will allow civil servants from other parts of the country to learn about the approach adopted by local authorities and public institutions at this level and how they are meeting the demand for providing services to Citizens. The Government of Ireland was requested as Coordinator of the Decentralization partner group, to fund accommodation costs for 41 participants travelling from different parts of Mozambique.
